title: Qualify strict symbolic provider output admission and complete M4-W01-C02
commitMessage: feat: qualify typed symbolic provider output admission and close C02

contribution.summary: Complete M4-W01-C02-T2 with a compiled missing-gate RED, 29 independent GREEN tests and eight NuGet-only consumer oracles. Deliver symbolics 0.5.0-preview.2 with a strict admission gate: only canonical native restricted IR matching a locally proven exact source is admitted. Reject opaque objects, provider text, changed/missing conditions and contradictory assumptions. Verify three local package hashes and close C02; keep M4-W01/C03 unfinished.
contribution.value: Prevent a symbolic provider's printed or opaque result from being accepted as mathematical truth without exact native IR restrictions, while retaining a provider-free Math package.
debtChanges: Compile an independent missing-public-gate RED against the existing preview.1 product before staging its implementation.
Pass 29 scientific GREEN tests for exact conditional identity, dropped/extra/wrong assumptions, hostile ToString refusal, symbol scope and budgets.
Return only a fresh local verified IR restriction, never a foreign object, arbitrary provider string, callback result or unchecked numeric approximation.
Run eight cross-boundary oracles through a single direct NuGet-only preview.2 consumer with no project/provider reference or outside feed.
Independently inspect the exact SHA-256, compiled net10.0 DLLs and dependency graphs of three newly built, local-only packages.
Retain locked Math build and complete relevant symbolics, IR and quantities regressions plus planning and transfer validations.
Close only T2 R/G/V, T2 and C02; keep M4/M4-W01 active and C03 planned, without any external CAS, AURA or dw.discovery integration claim.
contribution.nextAction: After RS056 durable success, prepare the next bounded controlled RED/GREEN for M4-W01-C03-T1 expansions, substitutions and capture-free symbolic transformations while preserving assumptions.

achievements.achievement: Observe a compiled RED for the missing public symbolic provider result admission API against the existing preview.1 product.
Implement native conditional IR output admission and pass 29 GREEN tests and eight independent NuGet client oracles without accepting opaque, lost-domain or external provider results.
Validate locked symbolics/IR/quantity suites, actual preview.2 package manifests and hashes, the source-only consumer and preserved owner boundaries.
Complete C02-T2 with a strict typed symbolic proposal filter, real controlled RED/GREEN evidence and explicit refusal of unrepresentable provider results.
Close M4-W01-C02 after its previously qualified exact T1 bridge and new T2 provider-output boundary; M4-W01 and C03 remain incomplete.
